Synopsis:
Russia's Transport Ministry issued clarifications to foreign airlines regarding airspace and airport safety, pushing back against Ukrainian President Zelenskiy's warning that Ukrainian drone activity has rendered Russian airspace unsafe. Western carriers have avoided Russian airspace since 2022; the remaining users are airlines from China, Turkey and Gulf states. The story reflects an ongoing and potentially escalating dimension of the Russia-Ukraine conflict — drone warfare extending into contested airspace.
